title: Mobile device mailbox policy does not allow unmanaged devices
description: The AllowNonProvisionableDevices property on the default mobile device mailbox policy MUST be False. Allowing unmanaged devices permits devices that cannot enforce the policy to connect, undermining mobile security controls. The CIS benchmark requires unmanaged devices to be blocked.
subject: Organization

references.name: CIS 3.2 (L1): Ensure Allow unmanaged devices is set to False
Mobile device mailbox policies in Exchange Server

remediation.description: Block unmanaged devices in the default mobile device mailbox policy.
remediation.scriptTemplate:
# Block unmanaged (non-provisionable) devices in the default mobile device mailbox policy.
Set-MobileDeviceMailboxPolicy -Identity Default -AllowNonProvisionableDevices $false

considerations: Blocking non-provisionable devices will prevent some older devices from synchronising. Evaluate the device inventory before enforcing this setting.
